remarks: Discover a rare blend of history, charm and modern comfort in this exceptional West Norwalk retreat set on a private 1.25 acres along one of the area's most cherished streets. Originally the North Five Mile River Schoolhouse, this one-of-a-kind home has been reimagined and updated for today's lifestyle while preserving its timeless character. The original living room impresses with soaring 12-foot ceilings, a marble fireplace and beautifully crafted wood floors. A formal dining room with a butler's pantry adds both elegance and functionality. The spacious country kitchen is designed for gathering, featuring new quartz countertops, a professional grade gas range , fireplace and an oversized island ideal for entertaining. Just beyond the sun-filled atrium serves as the heart of the home, offering warmth and natural light throughout the day. The first-floor primary suite includes a screened in porch perfect for gym or peaceful retreat. The primary bath features a new stand-alone bath and walk-through closet. Enjoy your first-floor family room and home office. The second floor boasts two spacious bedrooms and a hall bath. Step outside to a sweeping level lawn with picturesque stone walls and lush perennial gardens complete with gunite pool. Ample space for entertaining, relaxing or working from home. This exceptional property offers the tranquility of country living, just minutes from downtown Darien and New Canaan with convenient access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway.
